answer.origin: SEC EDGAR Form 8-K filed by NVIDIA Corporation, current report dated and published August 17, 2026 (Items 1.01, 2.03 and 7.01, with Exhibit 99.1 press release). Primary company filing; the stated event date is 2026-08-17.
answer.note: Source claim: on August 17, 2026 NVIDIA entered multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy (Lessor) covering leases for approximately 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site (PORTS Technology Campus, Pike County, Ohio), with an additional approximately 3.8 GW of credit support exercisable at NVIDIA's sole discretion. NVIDIA's aggregate payment obligation is cumulatively capped at $105 billion for its initial commitment. Payments are subject to conditions including the Lessor satisfying ready-for-service conditions, expected beginning in 2028. An affiliate of OpenAI Group PBC is the tenant; on a Trigger Event (OpenAI insolvency causing lease default, or OpenAI payment failure) NVIDIA pays generally the shortfall between a guaranteed minimum lease value and amounts recovered via replacement lease or sale. OpenAI has agreed to reimburse and indemnify NVIDIA for amounts actually paid. Obligations end at the earliest of the 20th anniversary of lease commencement, lease termination by OpenAI, OpenAI reaching a satisfactory credit rating, or other customary events. The filing states OpenAI will use capacity supporting about 4.25 GW to deploy NVIDIA's full-stack DSX AI factory platform, subject to limited exceptions. What this supports: a contingent credit-support obligation of up to $105 billion for NVIDIA, and a demand lead for NVIDIA AI infrastructure at one named campus. It does not by itself support NVIDIA revenue, orders or margin. Conditional interpretation: if the leases commence and the Lessor meets ready-for-service conditions, NVIDIA's contingent exposure becomes a live guarantee of up to the $105 billion initial cap, with economic loss depending on OpenAI performance and the recovery value of the premises. Hypothesis, not established by the source: the DSX platform deployment would be sourced from NVIDIA hardware and software sales in volumes that matter to NVIDIA results; the quoted facts would remain true if OpenAI sourced from other vendors within the 'limited exceptions' or if the deployment were priced separately from the guarantee. Missing premise: the commercial supply terms between NVIDIA and OpenAI or SB Energy for the platform.
limitations: The full text of the residual value guaranties is not in the supplied record; the summary is qualified by the Agreements and will be filed as an exhibit to the 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026, so guarantee mechanics such as the guaranteed minimum value formula, recovery definitions and cap allocation across the multiple Agreements are unverified.

The filing does not disclose lease commencement dates, lease economics, or whether all 4.25 GW of leases are already executed; the Agreements generally become effective only on lease commencement, so current effectiveness of each Agreement is not established.
The ready-for-service timing of 2028 is an expected timing in forward-looking statements and is not confirmed by the Lessor or any independent source.
The filing gives no expected NVIDIA revenue, product order value, or hardware share from the DSX deployment at Portsmouth; the demand link is qualitative.
The OpenAI affiliate's credit standing and the basis of the reimbursement and indemnity are not described beyond the summary; OpenAI's ability to fund the lease payments is unknown from this record.
The 3.8 GW additional credit support is discretionary and unquantified in dollar terms in the record, so its exposure is not established.
The record contains only NVIDIA's own disclosure; no independent confirmation of the Portsmouth campus scale, financing or OpenAI tenancy is supplied.
follow_up: Retrieve the exhibit to the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026 when filed and read the guaranteed minimum value, cap allocation, Trigger Event and termination language.
Check the 10-Q accounting disclosure for any guarantee liability, fair value recognition, or contingent obligation footnote, and the exposure amount recorded.
Check Exhibit 99.1 press release for any additional quantitative detail on campus scale, timing or NVIDIA product content.
Monitor public filings or statements by SB Energy and OpenAI for lease commencement, ready-for-service status and tenant payment performance at Portsmouth.
Check NVIDIA's next annual filing for disclosure of any payments made under these Agreements and for the product or revenue relationship with OpenAI or SB Energy.
